Record an independent worker heartbeat.

Source: R/acquisition_worker_health.R
acquisition_worker_health_heartbeat.Rd

Heartbeats contain lifecycle state only. Queue attempts and their byte receipts remain separate records.

Usage

acquisition_worker_health_heartbeat(
  catalog,
  worker_id,
  state = c("idle", "busy"),
  now = Sys.time()
)

Arguments

catalog

A catalog from acquisition_catalog_open().

worker_id

Stable worker process identity.

state

Either idle or busy.

now

Observation time, primarily for deterministic tests.

Value

A list with the worker identity and lifecycle state.
